narrative:
## Handover Summary — Revenue Planning

Care days and daily rates set for six facility types, 80 clinics, seven specialties and six payers across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

## Key Decisions
• German inpatient rehab care days raised 2.5% on the Paracelsus occupancy ramp-up
• Outpatient rehab raised 5% on DRV referral growth
• Austrian rehab daily rates indexed +3%
• Gap to EUR 1.30B ambition reduced from EUR 30M; remaining gap held as a stretch target

## Recommendation for Cost of Care
Plan nursing and therapy FTE against the new occupancy plan and price the tariff wage round explicitly — the margin is more sensitive to wages than to volume.
